title: AI Datacenter Microgrids Analysis Tool
description:
Technoeconomic model comparing levelized cost of electricity for AI datacenter power supply options (AC- and DC-coupled solar+storage, natural gas with diesel backup, and utility grid) at any location in the continental United States, including a speed-adjusted LCOE that prices the opportunity cost of GPU-hours lost to construction time.

This is the code accompanying Newkirk et al., "Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States" (arXiv:2611.17098). Methods, validation, and parameter sourcing are documented in that paper.
